title: 第13章 来签卖身契吧少女第14章 抵达北境
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: 莉莉丝浑身一抖。
她很清楚，自己的小命就攥在这两个人手里。
尤其是这个看起来斯斯文文的男人，杀起人来眼睛都不眨一下，一招手就抹平了一座山头。
“我说！我全说！”
莉莉丝竹筒倒豆子一样，把自己知道的全交代了。
“雇主是个黑袍人，浑身上下裹得严严实实，声音也是处理过的，根本看不出身份！”
“但是！”
眼看瑟薇娅的眉头皱了起来，莉莉丝赶紧补充。
“他给的定金是特制的金条，这些钱还在我这儿！只要有足够强的预言系法师，就能顺着金条找到他！”
说完，她一脸期待的看着洛加里斯和瑟薇娅，那表情仿佛在说：快夸我！这情报很有用吧！
然而，两人对视一眼，表情都有些微妙。
用钱追踪？
这算什么情报？
对方既然敢用这种方式付钱，就说明早就做好了被追踪的准备，这线索大概率没用。
更别说洛加里斯虽然会预言系术法，预言术式只能预测“物”的变化，想玩追踪还得另请高明。
眼看两人脸色不善，瑟薇娅的剑刃甚至又开始嗡鸣，莉莉丝的求生欲瞬间拉满。
“别别别！两位大人！我还有用！”
她急忙喊道：“我好歹也是个六阶战力！佣兵榜第三！留着我绝对比杀了我划算！我可以为两位大人效力！”
“六阶？”
瑟薇娅嗤笑一声，上下打量着她，那眼神，像是在看一件有瑕疵的商品。
“一个只会反魔法的六阶，术法一个不会，近战水平连我都打不过，要你何用？”
这话说得太扎心了。
莉莉丝的脸瞬间涨红。
她的“归零”领域确实是所有法师的噩梦，但她在斗技上没啥天赋，魔法更是练不了。
她的体术，全靠千锤百炼的身体本能，对付一般人绰绰有余，但碰上瑟薇娅这种怪物级别的剑士，就完全不够看了。
简直就是个偏科到极致的特长生。
就在莉莉丝窘迫得快要哭出来的时候，洛加里斯发话了。
“可以。”
他扶了扶眼镜，镜片后的眼神闪过一丝精光，像是发现了稀有材料的研究者。
“你的体质很特殊，我对反魔法的原理很感兴趣。正好，我缺个实验素材。”
实验素材？
content_en:
Lilith trembled all over.
She knew very well that her life was in the hands of these two people.
Especially this man who looks so gentle and gentle, he kills people without blinking an eye, and flattens a mountain with a wave of his hand.
"I'll tell you! I'll tell you everything!"
Lilith poured beans out of her bamboo tube and told her everything she knew.
"The employer is a man in black robes. He is wrapped up tightly and his voice has been processed so that his identity cannot be identified at all!"
"But!"
Seeing Serviya's brows furrowed, Lilith quickly added.
"The deposit he gave was a special gold bar, and I still have the money! As long as there is a strong enough prophecy mage, you can follow the gold bars to find him!"
After saying that, she looked at Logaris and Servia expectantly, as if her expressions were saying: Praise me! This information is very useful!
However, the two looked at each other with slightly subtle expressions.
Track with money?
What kind of information is this?
Since the other party dares to pay in this way, it means that he has been prepared to be tracked. This clue will most likely be useless.
Not to mention that although Logaris can predict the magic, the magic can only predict the changes of "objects", so if you want to track it, you have to hire another expert.
Seeing the unkind expressions on the two people's faces, Serviya's sword even started to buzz again, and Lilith's desire to survive was instantly heightened.
"No, no, no! You two adults! I'm still useful!"
She hurriedly shouted: "I am also a sixth-level warrior after all! Third on the mercenary list! It is definitely more cost-effective to keep me than to kill me! I can serve two adults!"
"Sixth level?"
Serviya sneered and looked her up and down, as if looking at a defective product.
"A sixth-level person who only knows anti-magic, but doesn't know any spells. He can't even beat me in melee. What use do you have?"
This is so heartbreaking to say.
Lilith's face instantly turned red.
Her "return to zero" field is indeed a nightmare for all mages, but she has no talent in fighting skills, and she can't practice magic.
Her physical skills rely entirely on her refined physical instincts, which are more than enough to deal with ordinary people, but they are completely inadequate against a monster-level swordsman like Serviya.
He is simply a talented student who is extremely partial to science.
Just when Lilith was about to cry in embarrassment, Logaris spoke.
"Okay."
He adjusted his glasses, and his eyes flashed behind the lenses, like a researcher who had discovered a rare material.
"Your physique is very special, and I am very interested in the principles of anti-magic. It just so happens that I am short of experimental materials."
Experimental material?
